message.reasoning:
We need to produce JSON with summary <=80 words, next_steps array of 3 strings, criteria object keyed by criterion id with feedback <=70 words each. Address student as "you". Be specific, cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state what next rubric level requires. Don't change marks. Don't comment on conversion artefacts. Don't make up explanations for unclear reasoning.

We need formative feedback. Marks are all Accomplished 9/10. Next level would be... rubric levels only Accomplished max 10, so next level is full 10 within Accomplished? We can say to reach the top of Accomplished (10/10) requires... Need be careful: "state what the next rubric level requires" — since they're at Accomplished, next level is full Accomplished? We can phrase "to move from 9 to 10 within Accomplished". That's acceptable.

Need cite sections/figures. Use evidence: 1 Introduction, 2.2 Launch, 2.3 Orbit, 2.4 Ground Control & Communications, 2.5 Mission Duration & EOL, Appendix A, Executive Summary, Figure 1, 3 Conclusion.

Technical issues: no full X-band link budget; 50 Mbit/s downlink and usable contact time assumed; Mount Pleasant must be fitted with S/X-band equipment; 9.7 min mean pass horizon-to-horizon including low-elevation contact, usable contact shorter though data budget uses discounted 34 min/day; Vega C not yet flown, Falcon 9 fallback sensible but different rideshare altitude requires SSO inclination and coverage analysis redone.

Need not make up explanations. We can mention these as actionable next steps.

Summary <=80 words: "Your ZYZZsat report is a strong, well-evidenced design that addresses every required element. You justify the single-spacecraft concept, launch and orbit choices, ground segment, duration and EOL with STK evidence and hand calculations. To reach the top of Accomplished, close the X-band link-budget gap, tighten pass-duration assumptions, and address Vega C/Falcon 9 trajectory sensitivity." Count words ~60. Good.

Next steps 3 strings: 
1. "In §2.4, add a full X-band link budget (EIRP, G/T, path loss, modulation/coding, margin) to support the 50 Mbit/s downlink and the assumed usable contact time; state Mount Pleasant S/X-band fit-out as a requirement or trade."
2. "Reconcile the 9.7 min mean pass in the Executive Summary/§2.4 with usable contact: define elevation mask and show how the 34 min/day data budget follows; update Figure/table if needed."
3. "In §2.2, treat Vega C availability as a schedule risk and quantify Falcon 9 fallback: redo SSO inclination and coverage analysis for the different rideshare altitude, or justify why coverage is insensitive."

Criteria feedback <=70 words each.

C1: "You address all introduction requirements in §1: mission need, single-spacecraft rationale, AIMS as operator and customers, and Australian benefits. Referencing is strong and rationale persuasive. To reach 10/10, evidence customer uses more directly (e.g., citations or requirements) rather than asserting them, and make the link from mission need to design requirements explicit." ~60 words.

C2: "Your §2.2–2.5 and Appendix A cover launch, orbit, manoeuvres, ground station, communications, duration and EOL with STK screenshots, trade tables and hand calculations. To reach 10/10, add the missing X-band link budget in §2.4, justify the 50 Mbit/s and usable-contact assumptions, and address Vega C schedule risk and Falcon 9 fallback coverage sensitivity in §2.2." ~60.

C3: "Your §3 conclusions are specific and tied to quantitative results, including four limitations. To reach 10/10, frame those limitations explicitly as design risks with likelihood/impact and mitigation, and state which next steps would retire each risk." ~40.

C4: "Your report is clearly structured and readable; the Executive Summary is concise, Figure 1 is labelled, and citations match the bibliography. To reach 10/10, tighten long tables and clarify summary-node-time wording, and ensure every figure/table is referenced in text before it appears." ~50.

Need JSON only. Ensure valid JSON. No markdown. Use double quotes. Criteria keys "C1" etc. Summary <=80 words. Next_steps exactly 3 strings. Criteria values <=70 words. Good.

Need maybe mention "next rubric level" — since Accomplished is top, say "top of Accomplished (10/10)". Fine.

Let's craft final JSON.
